name: lib_stir_cycle_ur5e_enc2_pgc_short01_u06_j8000
arm_name: ur5e_enc2 with the PGC-140-50 housing as drawn by DH (round body, R19 #12) instead of the 75 mm box
state: [carriage_x, base_y, base_yaw, q1, q2, q3, q4, q5, q6, finger_l, finger_r] (m, m, rad, rad x6, m, m)
spline_coords: [carriage_x, q1..q6] (m, rad); the other state values are const_state of the piece
joint_convention: joint values are the sim joint coordinates (Menagerie UR5e / vendor URDF FR5), in the joint order q1..q6 = base / shoulder / elbow / wrist 1-3; zero and sign must match the controller at commissioning [E]

certificate.checker: checker.Checker.check(full=True): MuJoCo contacts + GJK lower-bound certificate (distance.Bounds), 10 mm robot-environment, 5 mm gripper/held-environment, 0 mm self, joint ranges; R11 mesh rule for the held boxes (r19enc_check.meshheld); hit pairs re-measured with the exact convex bound (r19enc_check.one)
certificate.plume_rule: every robot geom except R_gripper_spatula*, R_cart*, R_dock* >= 0 mm from a cylinder of radius 0.20 m about the wok axis, rim .. 1.25 m (r15reach.py / r19stir_save.py), while the heat is on
certificate.spacing: consecutive checked states <= 4 mm apart by point_bound.segment_bound (r19smooth.FastBound, sub-steps <= 0.5 mm)
certificate.scene: r19stir_save.py SCENE=r17 (R17 kitchen: lid rack, spider rest at (1.52, .36), faucet), spatula held 0.45 m, jaw sense -1, cart at x 0.550

labels.note: the stored cycle labels (r19stir_cycle.label_shift rule; the entry is run with these labels)

stored_time_note: three cycles from rest (the stored law); steady period 14.031 s

certificate_reproduction.note: the certified states (stir scene) lie on the stored geometry: state fit = their distance to it

sequence.name: stir cycle (periodic, 5 strokes)
sequence.contact: stir: blade on the wok steel by design (R15 strokes); checked as stored, plume rule

fit.kind: the stored certified geometry, unchanged (C2 B-spline segments)

time_law.method: the stored from-rest jerk-limited law of the stir entry (3 cycles)

limits.A_UR_source: UR guidance, not a datasheet value: "moveJ accelerations should be less than 800deg/sec^2" (Universal Robots staff, https://forum.universal-robots.com/t/maximum-axis-speed-acceleration/13338); for a non-UR arm an ASSUMPTION
limits.jerk: no limit; moving-average filter W=0.1 s (r19smooth.timelaw), peaks reported
limits.jerk_source: A / 0.1 s with A = 800 deg/s^2: the R19_SMOOTH rule "full acceleration in >= 0.1 s" (ASSUMPTION, no OEM value) [E]
limits.A_note: A = min(800, J W / 2): with the moving-average filter W the time law alone adds a jerk up to ~2 A / W

playback.columns: t_s, carriage_x_m, base_y_m, base_yaw_rad, q1..q6_rad, finger_l_m, finger_r_m, element

state_fit.metric: global point bound (r19smooth.FastBound.g7, the bound on the displacement of every robot / held point) of the difference stored state - spline(parameter)

limits.method: np.gradient (central differences) of the 500 Hz samples, three times
